limitations: Population interests live only in the space's TOPIC block (unit 422-d vectors, zero in the affect and quantity blocks): individuals have no affect or quantity preferences; affinities are topic-block cosines (the MiniLM cosine the fitted click model takes), while CORE-SEM's space_read probe and click calibration use whole-vector cosines.

Every text a population world represents runs the space's whole text path, including the Qwen3-0.6B LM (valence, coherence): about 1.4 s per short text on one CPU thread the first time (disk-cached per machine and device class). Population, social and civ tests and runs belong in a GPU slot; a development civilisation records about 200-360 texts in 2 days.

Each recorded representation is held three times in a world (space_items row with base64 vector, float16 chunk vectors and features; the space.recorded event; the inference record), about 5 KB each per copy: long or large worlds grow accordingly (D1 limitation, now on the population's path).
